engineeringSkip.reason: Quantum-entangled neural linking between millions of people is a buzzword mash-up with no basis in known physics or biology — entanglement cannot transmit information, and no such neural interface exists or is proposed in serious research.

factCheck.reason: Quantum entanglement cannot transmit information — measuring one particle tells you nothing you can control about its partner — and there is no known way to wire millions of brains together directly, so the idea combines two things established physics and biology rule out.
